name: The Lightning God Defends (iQPS Launch 8)
agency: Institute for Q-shu Pioneers of Space
location_str: Rocket Lab LC-1B @ Rocket Lab Launch Complex 1, NZL
slot_a_text: Synthetic aperture radar Earth observation satellite for Japanese Earth imaging company iQPS.
slot_b_text: Rocket Lab's 14th launch of the year, 93rd all time. 4th from Rocket Lab LC-1B this year, 54 days since the last one. The 198th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year. Electron is on a 51 flight success streak.
footer_recovery: Recovery planned. Location to be confirmed.
description: Synthetic aperture radar Earth observation satellite for Japanese Earth imaging company iQPS.
rocket_fact: Electron's tanks are carbon composite liners overwrapped with carbon fiber, holding cryogenic fluid without a metal liner.
footer_right: Recovery planned. Location to be confirmed.
